name: Lakeshore East / former Newcastle–Oshawa local
description: Historically included the local Newcastle–Bowmanville–Courtice–Oshawa GO feeder. That local service ended in 2020, while 90B Union–Oshawa rail-replacement service continued. The number therefore remains current.

timeline.event: The Lakeshore East timetable includes the 90 Newcastle local, 90A Bowmanville short service, and 90B Union–Oshawa bus.
The original GTFS contains 90, 90A, 90B, 90C and 90D patterns.
Local route 90 was withdrawn after Durham Region Transit introduced overlapping 902A service; Metrolinx explicitly retained 90B.
The recovered original feed retains route 90B.

sources.title: GO Lakeshore East Table 09, printed effective August 30, 2008; includes bus routes 90/91
Original GO Transit GTFS archived January 11, 2016; use calendar validity, not retrieval date
Metrolinx: GO bus Route 90 to be discontinued, November 18, 2020
Original GO Transit GTFS archived May 5, 2023; use calendar validity, not retrieval date

gaps: The word “discontinued” in the 2020 announcement applies to the Durham local service, not the whole number 90 family.
Special construction shuttle suffixes are service-date-specific; see current GTFS validity rather than treating them as permanent routes.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
